title: TaskList/AddressBook/Calendar create requires defaulted props
description: Found while writing JMAP-1p88 tests. TaskList/set, AddressBook/set and Calendar/set creates that omit isSubscribed fail with invalidProperties 'missing field isSubscribed' (Calendar also 'missing field includeInAvailability'); see the fixtures in crate-jmap-{tasks,contacts,calendars}-server/tests/creation_refs.rs. RFC 8620 §5.3 has the server fill omitted properties that have a default and echo them in created. Verify against RFC 9610 §2 (AddressBook), draft-ietf-jmap-calendars-33 §4 (Calendar) and draft-ietf-jmap-tasks (TaskList) whether these properties have defaults or are server-set; if so, default them instead of failing the create.
